_comment: Providers and models used by the LIVE integration tiers. Edit this file to swap a model or switch a provider
off ("enabled": false), e.g. after looking at `lmctl ratelimit`. Command-line overrides win over this file:
Every live agent is started fresh (no resumed session).
agy: only the Gemini buckets matter; the agy 3p (third-party) bucket is never used or checked (issue 001).
requires_bin / requires_env are checked on the machine that runs the tests BEFORE anything else; a missing one
stops the run with a report line. Credentials are never printed. On the awsspot box an env value that is not in
the login environment is read from ~/.config/lmctl/live-env (mode 600, lines like: export OLLAMA_API_KEY=...).

tiers: which suites use a provider. "live" = live.lms, prompt.lms, merged-api-live, lmctl-cron-test, lmplayer-live, pref-overlay-live; "smoke" = tests/provider-smoke.mjs (seed, ping, three-turn sum). Default: both.

model "" means: do not pass a model, the provider uses its own default (copilot, opencode, kimi, hermes, miniplayer, muse, pi). tier "periodic" = cheap enough for the hourly check (kimi has a scarce weekly quota and copilot bills premium requests, so both are smoke-only).

Ollama Cloud (OLLAMA_API_KEY) serves lmplayer, opencode, pi and hermes (model names differ per tool: lmplayer/opencode "ollama-cloud/<m>", hermes "ollama-cloud:<m>", pi "ollama-cloud/<m>" via a custom provider in ~/.pi/agent/models.json). copilot uses gpt-5-mini. No model at all ("") = provider default.
cron_model is the model token the lmctl-cron-test suite passes to `lmctl cron create --model` (only codex and agy are supported there).

observed_model: the name a session is expected to REPORT when it differs from the declared model string by convention (lmplayer/Ollama strips its "ollama-cloud/" prefix). billing "credit": the provider draws from a flat-credit plan, not per-token billing, so no source-qualified price route is expected -- the live comparison pins that unpriced state instead of reporting a differ (mono 009).

muse._note: DISABLED 2026-10-11 by the operator until the operator has evaluated muse's value; do NOT re-enable on your own (not when the quota resets). Muse works multi-turn. Seed accepted it from lmctl 0.2.157 on (issue 025); older builds reject it with "invalid provider". SDK: ~/repos/providers/muse-code-sdk

miniplayer._note: miniplayer cannot be seeded or resumed (lmctl: "miniplayer does not support team session resume; use lmctl prompt --provider miniplayer"), and has no compact. The smoke test therefore runs it anonymously (lm_agent, fresh each call): ping and a one-prompt sum.
